onset.Description: Onset of the event relative to the start of the recording. Stimulus onsets come from the photodiode-gated trigger, which fires at the true screen onset roughly 12 ms after the parallel-port code.

duration.Description: Time the image stayed on screen; 0 for markers

sample.Description: Onset expressed as a sample index into the recording

Levels.trained: One of the 48 objects the participant trained on
Levels.untrained: One of the 48 objects the participant did not train on
Levels.catch: Catch image requiring a button press; not analysed
Levels.response: Button press on the response channel, recorded during the catch detection task

value.Description: Trigger code on STI101. Stimulus codes are 2**15 minus the image number, so object_id = 2**15 - value - 1. Block markers use codes 101 to 120.

object_id.Description: Object identity, 0 to 95. Values 0 to 47 are trained objects and 48 to 95 are untrained. n/a for catch trials and block markers.

stimulus_id.Description: Filename of the image presented. The images themselves are not redistributed with this dataset; see the README.

Levels.photodiode: Photodiode-gated trigger, the true screen onset
Levels.trigger_shifted: Parallel-port code advanced by 12 samples, used where the photodiode marker is absent
Levels.trigger: Parallel-port code, used for block markers

analysis_include.Description: 1 if this presentation entered the analyses reported in the manuscript, 0 otherwise. Set by matching each trigger against the epoched dataset on OSF, so selecting analysis_include == 1 reproduces that trial set exactly. Catch trials and trials from aborted, restarted blocks are 0.
